title: Daily Summary — 2026-05-14
body:
## Recent Activity

Two issues were active yesterday (2026-05-13), both opened and actively discussed by @lolipopshock. No pull requests, discussions, or commits were synced in the lookback window.

**Issue #36 — Upgrade sepo** reached a decision point: sepo-agent identified that the repo's install predates the v0.1.0 release (new workflows: `agent-onboarding`, `agent-project-manager`, `agent-release-prepare`, `agent-update`; updated `acpx` dependency). @lolipopshock followed with `/implement` to proceed with the upgrade.

**Issue #37 — Video captions** had a detailed design discussion. sepo-agent recommended keeping captions in this repo under `content/captions/`, using a `Transcript.tsx` component with EN/ZH tab toggle, and a GitHub Actions workflow to download captions via `yt-dlp` and translate them via Claude. @lolipopshock approved the direction and asked for two stacked PRs (infra first, then workflow). sepo-agent drafted a full plan and is waiting on one open question: whether the transcript component should preserve clickable timestamps for the embedded YouTube player.

## Recently Active PRs

No pull requests were synced in this window.

## Recently Active Issues

- [augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io#36](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/36) — **Upgrade sepo** (open) — `/implement` dispatched; upgrade targets v0.1.0 files from `self-evolving/repo`
- [augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io#37](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/37) — **Should we include captions in this repo or a separate one?** (open) — Plan finalized; two stacked PRs planned (caption infra + workflow); one open question pending

## Recently Active Discussions

No discussions were synced in this window.

## Follow-ups

1. **Answer the open question on #37**: decide whether the `Transcript` component should render clickable timestamps (YouTube player seek) or plain paragraph text — this unblocks the stacked PR implementation.
2. **Check on #36 implementation**: verify whether the `/implement` dispatch for the sepo v0.1.0 upgrade produced a PR; if not, re-trigger.
3. **After #36 merges**: confirm `agent-update.yml` is active and schedule the biweekly auto-update going forward.
